newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver prices gain, gold steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver prices gain, gold steady.

text.p: Indian silver prices recovered on Wednesday from recent losses while gold held sway, dealers said.
"Overall, the bullion market is technically oversold at current levels and may attract some upward correction," one dealer said.
Silver fell by 90 rupees per kg in the past two days while gold eased by 10 rupees per 10 grammes on Tuesday.
"Seasonal silver buying was low but industrial consumers returned to the market today," one broker said.
